enchantments.tooltip: Subtle Target: Once per minute, when you use Diplomacy, you gain a -100% Profane bonus to threat generation with weapon strikes for 20 seconds.

Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +9 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
Diversion +7%: +7% Enhancement bonus to decreased threat generated from melee damage.
Distant Diversion +7%: +7% Enhancement bonus to decreased threat generated from ranged damage.
Mystic Diversion +7%: +7% Enhancement bonus to decreased threat generated from spell damage.
Mythic Cloak Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
